IS 3025 : Part 38 : 2025 Methods of Sampling and Test (Physical and Chemical) for Water and Wastewater - Part 38 Dissolved Oxygen
ICS 13.060.50
ICS 13.060.50
CHD 36
CHD 36
1 SCOPE
This standard (Part 38) prescribes the following methods for determination of dissolved oxygen in water and wastewater:
a) Titrimetric method;
b) Electrometric method; and
c) Optical-Probe Method (This method is applicable to waters containing 0.05 mg/l to 20.00 mg/l DO)
